entities.summary: Naruhito, a notable figure in the history of Japan, associated with Heisei and Reiwa Eras (2019–2025). Preceded by Tōhoku earthquake, tsunami, and Fukushima nuclear disaster and Great Hanshin (Kobe) earthquake kills over 6,000. Their legacy influenced Tokyo hosts the delayed 2020 Olympic Games without spectators and Former Prime Minister Abe Shinzō assassinated.
